name: Greentown China Holdings Limited (绿城中国控股有限公司)
note: Property developer listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX 03900). Per its 2026 interim report, its single largest shareholder is China Communications Construction Group (Limited) (CCCG), interested in approximately 28.88% (733,456,293 shares, 28.881% as at 30 June 2026) through wholly-owned subsidiaries; the same filing describes CCCG as a wholly state-owned company. The second-largest block is the Wharf (Holdings)/Wheelock/HSBC Trustee chain with 581,667,293 shares (22.904%).
